# Your Tanzania Trip

> Tailor-made trips through Tanzania: private safaris in the north and the south, Kilimanjaro climbs, Zanzibar beach stays and the Great Migration. Planned and booked from the Netherlands by Tijs Krops and Edrian Waterman; run on the ground by our local partner Kilimanjaro Nature Tours in Arusha, founded by Baraka Dalali. Private guide and your own safari vehicle on every safari. A free, no-obligation travel proposal within 24 hours. Prices on the site are per person in USD, based on 6 travellers in low season, excluding international flights.

Company: Your Tanzania Trip (Tijs Krops), Sluitgatweg 10, 8308 RE Nagele, Netherlands. KvK 97223344, VAT NL005256557B94. Phone/WhatsApp +31 6 29351377 (English and Dutch).
Local partner: Kilimanjaro Nature Tours, P.O. Box 611, USA River, Arusha, Tanzania. +255 787 301 259, info@kilimanjaronaturetours.com, https://kilimanjaronaturetours.com. Rated 5.0 on Tripadvisor (208 reviews, checked 27 October 2026); that score belongs to the partner, not to Your Tanzania Trip.

## Trips
- [11 Days Tanzania Safari & Zanzibar](https://yourtanzaniatrip.com/itineraries/11-days-safari-trip-tanzania-zanzibar/): Five days on safari in Tarangire, the Serengeti and the Ngorongoro Crater, then a flight to Zanzibar for the beach. Private guide and vehicle. From $2,181 p.p.
- [15 Days Tanzania Safari & Zanzibar](https://yourtanzaniatrip.com/itineraries/15-days-trip-tanzania-zanzibar/): Two weeks at an easy pace: Arusha, Tarangire, three days in the Serengeti, the Ngorongoro Crater and four days on Zanzibar. Private guide. From $3,039 p.p.
- [9 Days Migration Safari, Mara River](https://yourtanzaniatrip.com/itineraries/9-days-safari-wildebeest-migration-near-the-mara-river/): Nine days built around the Great Migration: Tarangire, the central Serengeti, two days by the Mara River and the Ngorongoro Crater. From $2,365 p.p.
- [7 Days Northern Tanzania Safari](https://yourtanzaniatrip.com/itineraries/7-days-safari-tanzania/): One week, three parks: Lake Manyara, two days in the Serengeti and the Ngorongoro Crater, with a private guide and your own 4×4. From $1,599 p.p. in low season.
- [Climb Kilimanjaro, Machame Route 7 days](https://yourtanzaniatrip.com/itineraries/machame-route-7-days/): Seven days on the Machame Route to Uhuru Peak with Baraka's licensed guides, cook and porters; nine days including arrival and departure. From $2,329 p.p.
- [10 Days Zanzibar Beach Holiday](https://yourtanzaniatrip.com/itineraries/10-days-zanzibar-island/): Ten days on Zanzibar: a beach hotel in three comfort levels, airport transfers, and reef trips, spice farms or Stone Town added as you like. From $625 p.p.
- [10 Days Southern Tanzania Safari](https://yourtanzaniatrip.com/itineraries/10-days-safari-mikumi-udzungwa-ruaha-nyerere/): Mikumi, the Udzungwa Mountains, Ruaha and Nyerere in ten days: quiet parks, a waterfall hike, a boat safari on the Rufiji and two flights. From $3,180 p.p.
- [5-Day Small Group Safari Tanzania](https://yourtanzaniatrip.com/itineraries/5-day-tanzania-safari-small-group-trip/): Five days in a small group of 3 to 6 travellers: Tarangire, Serengeti and the Ngorongoro Crater. Monthly departures from Arusha, single room included. From $1,570.

- [Tanzania Safari: 20+ Private Tour Packages](https://yourtanzaniatrip.com/tanzania-safari/): Dreaming of the ultimate Tanzania Safari experience? ✅Book Private Trip! Best itineraries for Tanzania Safari ✅Private Guide ✅Free Quote

- [Zanzibar Vacation Packages - Book Now!](https://yourtanzaniatrip.com/zanzibar-holiday/): Going on a Zanzibar holiday? Check out the most beautiful resorts, best vacation packages and the most exciting excursions.
- [Great Migration: where and when to go](https://yourtanzaniatrip.com/great-wildebeest-migration/): Where the wildebeest herds are each month, when the Mara and Grumeti crossings happen, where to stay and how far ahead to book. Advice from our team in Arusha.
- [Zanzibar beaches, reefs and Stone Town](https://yourtanzaniatrip.com/islands/zanzibar-island/): Zanzibar in one page: which coast to choose, our three favourite places to stay, what to do from spice farms to Mnemba, flights from Arusha and when to go.
- [Discover Tanzania's National Parks with Your Tanzania Trip](https://yourtanzaniatrip.com/national-parks-tanzania/): Explore Tanzania's National Parks. Discover the Beauty, Wildlife, and Adventure Awaits in East Africa's Most Iconic Parks.
- [Lodges, camps and beach hotels in Tanzania](https://yourtanzaniatrip.com/accommodations/): The lodges, tented camps and beach resorts we book in Tanzania, in three comfort levels. More than 100 of them visited by us, with honest notes on each.
- [Safari activities and excursions in Tanzania](https://yourtanzaniatrip.com/activities/): Balloon flights, walking safaris, Maasai village visits, boat trips, snorkelling and Stone Town tours: the activities you can add to any Tanzania trip with us.
- [Free Hakuna Matata support package](https://yourtanzaniatrip.com/hakuna-matata-package/): Every trip includes our free Hakuna Matata Package: travel file, airport pick-up, private guide, 24/7 support, replacement vehicle and help with disrupted flights.
- [Practical information for your Tanzania trip](https://yourtanzaniatrip.com/practical-information/): Visas, vaccinations, money, packing, flights, insurance and payments: the practical side of a Tanzania trip, explained by the team that plans it.
- [Tanzania travel FAQ: visas, money, safety](https://yourtanzaniatrip.com/faqs/tanzania/): Eighty questions travellers ask us before a Tanzania trip, answered plainly: visas, money, safety, packing, lodges, safari days and how booking works.
- [Tanzania travel blog: parks, planning, packing](https://yourtanzaniatrip.com/blog/): Articles from our team on Tanzania's parks and islands, the best months to travel, what to pack, what things cost and how a safari day really looks.
